description: Autonomous agents may not install, load, or activate a network device firmware / OS image (Junos, ArubaOS, ArubaOS-CX, Aruba Instant). Firmware changes — especially downgrades — require human approval because they can silently reintroduce known CVEs and reset feature flags.
message: Blocked: this action would change network device firmware. Firmware updates and especially downgrades require human approval — an autonomous agent should propose the version and change window, not commit it.
guidance: Write the firmware plan (target version, affected devices, rollback path, change window) to remediation.log and open a change ticket. An authorized operator can approve and stage the change in the Conduct console.
